The company also announced the opening of a second office in downtown San Francisco and the addition of senior leaders from Meta, Anduril, Applied Intuition, Grafana Labs, SpaceX, and Palantir to its 80-person team. Co-founder Karthik Gollapudi will shift his focus to product vision and industry evangelism.
